title: Add image semantic pipeline

context.summary: Add an image semantic processing path that produces derived caption, analysis and OCR-ready artifacts searchable through the existing document search.
context.background: TASK-42 indexes attachment metadata and TASK-43 proved modality extraction can create artifact-backed semantic text. Image routing still skipped as processor_not_implemented.

in: Route enabled image uploads to document.extract.
Add a dedicated image semantic extractor module with deterministic metadata/OCR-ready fallback behavior.
Create image_caption, image_analysis, ocr_text and image_embedding derived artifacts when image extraction runs.
Propagate semantic artifact refs into chunk metadata and search source refs.
Record configured model-runtime capability state for OCR, image captioning and image embeddings.
Add integration coverage for PNG upload, semantic extraction and phrase search.
Update docs, validators and workspace wiring.
out: Standalone visual vector search over image embeddings.

acceptance_criteria: Enabled image routing creates a document.extract job.
Image extraction writes image_caption and image_analysis artifacts with text spans.
Image OCR state is represented as derived metadata and OCR text artifacts are created when embedded image text is available.
Chunk metadata/source refs include image semantic artifacts.
Image document search returns source-backed hits for semantic description and OCR text.
Configured OCR, image-captioning and image-embedding capability state is recorded without mutating RAW originals.

manual_checks: Confirm image search hits include semantic artifact metadata.

risks: The MVP image extractor uses deterministic metadata and embedded text fallback until a real vision/OCR adapter is installed.
Image embedding artifacts record capability state but do not yet store visual vectors.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
